en: The Triplet on the Cause of Seeing (Dassanahetuttika)

Dependent on a state whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, there arises a state whose root is not to be abandoned by seeing, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are twenty-six;

under object [condition], twenty-one; under predominance [condition], nineteen ... pe ... under resultant [condition], three ... pe ... under non-disappearance [condition], twenty-six. (To be expanded in detail.)
